digest.component_or_area: CloudWatch monitoring alarms and SNS notifications
propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors and replication_errors) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, so they fire silently with no notification to operators despite meeting their own stated purpose of surfacing problems.

An audit of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks in infra/terraform/ reveals 11 correctly wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; these two are the only omissions, establishing it as the repo convention rather than an operator choice.

A guard test must be added to parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block and fail on any lacking alarm_actions or ok_actions unless explicitly marked with a rebar:allow-actionless-alarm opt-out comment, with a mandatory anti-vacuity assertion to prevent vacuous passes.

Merging the HCL fix does not apply it to AWS; live describe-alarms continues to show empty AlarmActions/OKActions for both alarms until terraform apply is run by an operator, leaving the production alarms still silent.
The comment in monitoring_1fa8.tf claiming it mirrors S4b by wiring SNS while S4b does not is false and must be corrected; both should wire SNS per the same rationale (ADR-0013 gate dependency).
